name: Nitrosend
description:
Nitrosend is AI-Native Email: a full email service provider built for the MCP era, where Claude is the interface. Connect once with OAuth and Claude can run your entire email program: no tab-switching, no drag-and-drop editor, no CSV wrangling.

What Claude can do with Nitrosend:

• Compose on-brand emails with a section-based designer. A composition contract feeds Claude your brand kit, voice, and design context so drafts come out on-brand, then validates them before anything persists.
• Send campaigns to lists and segments, with review, test sends, and an explicit approval step before anything goes live.
• Build automation flows (welcome series, cart abandonment, win-backs) from triggers, waits, splits, and webhooks.
• Send transactional email: receipts, OTPs, password resets, single recipient, immediate, idempotent.
• Import and manage contacts: CSV imports up to 250k rows, segments, tags, lists, and TCPA/GDPR-aware opt-in handling.
• Verify sending domains, configure senders, and read deliverability-aware analytics with trends and benchmarks.

Safety is built in: read-only tools are annotated as such, destructive actions prompt, sends require explicit approval, and large imports hold for review. Docs: docs.nitrosend.com

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nitrosend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nitrosend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.nitrosend.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nitrosend MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nitrosend lists 25 MCP tools, including nitro_compose_campaign, nitro_compose_flow, nitro_configure_account, nitro_configure_providers, nitro_control_delivery, nitro_define_segment, nitro_get_insights, nitro_get_status, nitro_import_contacts, nitro_ingest, nitro_manage_audience, and nitro_manage_billing.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nitrosend?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Nitrosend in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Nitrosend requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nitrosend is developed by Nitrosend. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
